claim: Try the reviewer with a risky sample plan.
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:risky-sample-review
sandbox: fresh browser context; open /demo/ and assert the populated sample reports its reserved-name error

claim: Demo — sample data, nothing is saved.
test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:demo-isolated
sandbox: save a real draft, edit /demo/, then prove the real draft returns unchanged

test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:local-only
sandbox: capture every request while loading and editing the demo; assert all requests are same-origin

test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:offline-reload
sandbox: visit /demo/, wait for the service worker, take the browser offline, and reload

test: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:dry-run-export
sandbox: make the demo sample safe, download the shell plan, and assert its mode prints commands only
